presentation.speaker: sunny_adeyemi
presentation.title: Electricity tariff increase
lines: The grid raised commercial tariffs by 25%. Hold your prices and take the margin hit, or pass the cost on to drivers.

choices.label: Hold charging prices
choices.outcome: Margins shrink while the tariff eases over two months.

choices.label: Raise prices by $0.05 per kWh
choices.outcome: Margins hold, but fewer drivers plug in.
